messages:
maria: Quick prototype FYI — added a tiny console card that shows per-route 'token margin' (raw token cost minus cache credits) + a sparkline and route breakdown. Putting screenshot in #design and a staging link: https://staging.console.redwood/econ/token-margins

aj: Nice! How are you calculating cache credits? per-prefix KV hits or amortized prefetch credits?

maria: For the prototype I used prefix hits * avg_cached_token_cost (7d avg) as a conservative estimate. Prefetch amortization is a second pass — doing it offline for now.

kevin: If we want accurate per-invocation margins we'll need to extend econ telemetry: tokens_generated, tokens_served_from_cache, model_sku, route_id, routing_variant. Heads up: that increases event size. Suggest: sample 0.5% full payload + aggregated counters for others.

maria: Event sketch I used in the prototype (for discussion):
```json
{
  "route_id": "string",
  "model_sku": "rwd-4b-q4",
  "tokens_generated": 128,
  "tokens_cached": 32,
  "routing_variant": "sticky-v2",
  "timestamp": 1610000000
}
```

aj: Sampling makes sense. We should also expose a console control for sampling rate per-tenant so platform teams can raise it for high-sensitivity customers.

sophie: Product ask: can the card toggle between per-tenant and org-aggregate? Need a compact explainer copy for customers + a canary toggle for the rollout. Also show 'what changed' when routing policy flips — that will help SREs.

deploy-bot: econ-viz/feature-token-margins passed CI and deployed to staging (env=staging, sha=abc123) :rocket:

kevin: Operational note — sticky-routing and fallback-to-cheaper-model will shift margins in non-obvious ways. We should tag aggregated points with routing_policy_version and include a small annotation when we detect >5% margin delta correlated with a routing change.

aj: We'll need to surface sampling error bars on the card if sampling < 1%. Simple conf interval should be enough. Also recommend a 7-day rolling window to smooth noise.

maria: Plan proposal: 1) add minimal telemetry fields (kevin) 2) offline aggregator job (batch) to compute per-route margins and amortize prefetch costs (aj) 3) staging card + canary flag + UI toggle for per-tenant (sophie) 4) annotate routing policy changes in the timeseries (kevin). I'll open PRs and a follow-up RFC.

sophie: Scheduling: put a 30m design review this Friday 10:30am PT. I'll prepare the explainer: 'Token margin = raw token cost - cache credits - prefetch amortization'. Keep the card minimal at first.

aj: Quick sampling math for the review: effective variance ~ p*(1-p)/n where p=sample rate, n=samples; with 0.5% and ~100k events/day we'll get ~500 samples/day per route — CI will be wide for small routes but fine for top routes.

maria: Action items: @kevin sketch event schema in a PR, @aj add sampling circuit and offline aggregator job, @sophie mock UI + explainer, i'll wire staging card and open rollout feature flag. Thanks! :thumbsup:

kevin: I'll drop a draft schema in the infra repo today and tag you all.

maria: Awesome, thanks all — will follow up with links to PRs and the staging card once ready.
